title: Find one record by primary key
purpose: Rebuild an explicit layout context, find by a resolved primary-key field, and distinguish zero, one, and multiple matching records.
preconditions: The target layout is based on the intended table occurrence.
The primary-key field and value expression are resolved from target-solution metadata and an approved input contract.
The find criterion uses a reviewed exact-match or escaping strategy so user input cannot become a FileMaker find operator.
The caller does not require the previous layout, current record, found set, or sort order to survive this pattern.

placeholders.name: TARGET_TABLE_OCCURRENCE
placeholders.resolutionSource: the resolved base table occurrence of {{TARGET_LAYOUT}}

placeholders.name: PRIMARY_KEY_FIELD
placeholders.resolutionSource: target FileMaker solution metadata and data-model contract

placeholders.name: RESULT_FIELD_MAP
placeholders.resolutionSource: the approved output contract and target FileMaker solution metadata

steps.name: Set Error Capture
steps.purpose: Keep find errors under explicit script control.

partialConditions.psos: FMSE always behaves as Set Error Capture On; do not depend on an Off state.
partialConditions.server_schedule: FMSE always behaves as Set Error Capture On; do not depend on an Off state.

steps.name: Go to Layout
steps.purpose: Establish the layout and table-occurrence context explicitly.

partialConditions.psos: Do not use animation; resolve the layout explicitly because client context is not inherited.
partialConditions.server_schedule: Do not use animation; resolve the layout explicitly because no client context exists.

steps.name: Enter Find Mode
steps.purpose: Enter Find mode without pausing for user input.

partialConditions.psos: Pause must be Off because FMSE cannot provide interactive input.
partialConditions.server_schedule: Pause must be Off because FMSE cannot provide interactive input.

steps.name: Set Field
steps.purpose: Put the resolved, exact-match-safe criterion into {{PRIMARY_KEY_FIELD}}.

steps.name: Perform Find
steps.purpose: Execute the single-key find and establish an independent found set.

steps.name: Set Variable
steps.purpose: Capture Get ( LastError ) immediately and then store Get ( FoundCount ).

steps.name: If
steps.purpose: Branch on find error and found count.

steps.name: Else
steps.purpose: Keep zero, one, and multiple-result branches readable.

steps.name: Exit Script
steps.purpose: Return a common JSON result without exposing a FileMaker record object.

functions.name: Get ( LastError )
functions.purpose: Capture the Perform Find result before another step changes it.

functions.name: Get ( FoundCount )
functions.purpose: Distinguish zero, one, and multiple matching records.

functions.name: JSONSetElement
functions.purpose: Build the result envelope and a synthetic field map.

happyPath: Validate the JSON input using the json-parameter-validation pattern.
Go to {{TARGET_LAYOUT}} and confirm that its base context is {{TARGET_TABLE_OCCURRENCE}}.
Enter Find Mode with Pause Off.
Set {{PRIMARY_KEY_FIELD}} to a reviewed exact-match criterion derived from {{PRIMARY_KEY_VALUE_EXPRESSION}}.
Perform Find and immediately store Get ( LastError ).
Store Get ( FoundCount ) after preserving the find error.
Return RECORD_NOT_FOUND for zero results, OK with fields from {{RESULT_FIELD_MAP}} for exactly one result, and PRIMARY_KEY_NOT_UNIQUE for multiple results.

errorBranches.trigger: The find has empty or invalid criteria.
errorBranches.action: Return an input/design error and do not continue with a broad found set.

errorBranches.trigger: Perform Find returns FileMaker error 401 or the preserved found count is zero.
errorBranches.action: Return a normal not-found business result.

errorBranches.trigger: Get ( FoundCount ) is greater than one.
errorBranches.action: Return a data-integrity error and do not select an arbitrary record.

errorBranches.trigger: Perform Find returns a nonzero error other than the explicitly handled result codes.
errorBranches.action: Return the preserved FileMaker code and stop.

concurrencyNotes: A matching record can be changed or deleted after the find; write patterns must open or lock it before modification.
PSOS and schedules operate in independent sessions and must rebuild the layout and found set every time.
A uniqueness rule in the data model is the durable protection against duplicate primary keys; the find alone is not.
securityNotes: Verify read privileges before returning mapped field values.
Return only fields in {{RESULT_FIELD_MAP}} and never serialize a FileMaker record or internal object identifier.
Do not include hidden or sensitive fields merely because the layout context can access them.
